title: The other-locations hint on Edit Library Part does not count a location that only received the number
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. API replays from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Data: QAPL-LK1 (stocked at Staging Lethbridge only; note its description and the entry id from /parts-catalogue/{id}). Staging Heavy Duty has no QAPL-LK1 part at the start.
custom_steps:
1. At Staging Heavy Duty, create a PO with a hand-typed (special-order) line "QAPL-LK1", qty 1, not linked to an inventory part, and receive it in full.
  2. Replay GET /api/inventory/parts/list-workplaces?catalogPart=<QAPL-LK1 entry id>.
  3. Switch to Staging Lethbridge > Parts > Part Library > open QAPL-LK1 > pencil; change the Description, then the Part Number, without saving.
  4. Close the window (X). Switch to Staging Heavy Duty > Inventory > New Inventory Part: Description = QAPL-LK1's description, Part Number "QAPL-LK1" exactly, Category, a default bin > Save.
  5. Switch to Staging Lethbridge > Part Library > open QAPL-LK1 > pencil; change the Description, then the Part Number, without saving.
  6. Close the window (X). Switch to Staging Heavy Duty > Inventory > open the new QAPL-LK1 part > Delete Part.
custom_expected:
1. The line is received; Inventory at Staging Heavy Duty still has no QAPL-LK1 part.
  2. 200: the Staging Lethbridge row plus a Staging Heavy Duty row for the location that only received the number, with isTracked: true and isActive: true.
  3. No "This also changes …" hint under either field: Staging Heavy Duty only received the number and does not count.
  4. The part is created at Staging Heavy Duty and linked to the existing QAPL-LK1 entry; the Part Library still lists QAPL-LK1 once.
  5. "This also changes the description at 1 other location." and "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." show.
  6. The part is deleted at once with no confirmation; QAPL-LK1 is stocked at Staging Lethbridge only again.
